cards.title: Rider's chat
cards.text: Puts the agent inside Rider's AI chat over the Agent Client Protocol.

cards.title: One line, one message
cards.text: JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout. Thinking, text and tool cards stream back as they come.

cards.title: Sessions and files
cards.text: A working folder and a history per chat. Only the files you attach are read.
